caption: A curved twin handle cooking pot with sealed base, cavity and open rim. Walls surround the interior; two handles join opposite sides to provide functional grips. Oval continuous walls enclose the cavity; a thick rim and sealed base join those walls. Overall width is 1.93 times depth; height is 0.28 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous blue, dark brown, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
